title: 1984 Topps - All-Star #388 Mike Schmidt Philadelphia Phillies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1984 Topps All-Star #388 trading card features the legendary baseball player Mike Schmidt of the Philadelphia Phillies. The card is part of the base set and is perfect for any collector or fan of the Major League Baseball (MLB). It is a sports trading card that showcases Schmidt's talent and impact on the game.

The card is from the 1984 season and is not autographed. It is a great addition to any sports memorabilia collection and is a must-have for fans of the Philadelphia Phillies. Get your hands on this iconic trading card and add it to your collection today!
